data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 256.3 million for 2022. This movement includes the impact of the P&C UK 2019 & Prior YOA RITC transaction, which transferred liabilities, and a release of COVID-19 related reserves (decreasing from GBP 175.8 million in 2021 to GBP 77.2 million in 2022). These favourable developments occurred despite pressures from economic inflation, exacerbated by the war in Ukraine, which led to increased loss estimates for both current and prior year business. Prior year events like Winterstorm Uri and Hurricane Ida in 2021 also contributed to the loss ratio.
raw_causal_phrases: resulted in increased loss estimates for both our current and prior year business.
The war in Ukraine added to the pressure that was already building on inflation due to supply chain disruption following the Covid pandemic.
The movements arising from prior year claims include the impact of the P&C UK 2019 & Prior YOA RITC as well as other movements in estimates.

The economic inflation environment introduces uncertainty into the level of claims payments. This has been subject to extensive analysis in 2022 with explicit provisions held to cover this risk. These provisions are held in addition to those derived using actuarial techniques, which assume a continuation of historical inflation into the future.
The remaining reserves in respect of the Covid claims were GBP 77.2 million (2021: GBP 175.8 million)
